title: Claim (a Claims row as a pull writes it)
description: One line of norm/claims.jsonl: a row of Claims as plain values. The agent writes eight columns: Agent tags and Tags waiting (relations to the Rulebook, resolved here to tag names), Agent confidence, Agent reasons, Agent status, Agent edition, Agent remarks and Agent's view of your decision (agent_reading: one line per tag the agent read a disagreement on, lib/readings.mjs). Claims has no editor column on v2: the decisions are on Tag decisions rows (ledger-row.schema.json).

geo_id.description: The claim's identity in Geo; the key of the row.

agent_tags.description: Agent tags (a relation to the Rulebook), as tag names: the tags that apply, decided or proposed, and are not waiting for an editor.

agent_status.description: What the agent says about the claim; empty until the first tag run has read it.

tags_waiting.description: Tags waiting (a relation to the Rulebook copy), as tag names: the judged tags that wait for the editor.

agent_confidence.description: The lowest confidence among the tags the agent judged on the claim.

agent_reasons.description: One line per judged tag: "<Tag>: <reason> · <rule cited> · <k> of <n> runs agree".

agent_edition.description: The rulebook edition the row was written under.

agent_remarks.description: "not checked: <counts by kind>" when the agent could not check some tags of the rulebook, else empty.

agent_reading.description: One line per tag the agent read a disagreement on ("<Tag>: <reading>, rule <n> · <note>") or the agree line; empty until distill has read the claim.
